newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: SWISS LAUNCH THREE-MONTH MONEY MARKET CLAIMS.
newsitem.headline: SWISS LAUNCH THREE-MONTH MONEY MARKET CLAIMS.

text.p: The Swiss federal government is issuing three-month money market claims series 3.399 to be paid for on August 14, the Swiss National Bank said.
The allocation follows the end of subscriptions on August 12.
The previous issue of three-month claims, series 3.398, which settled on August 7, raised roughly 1.015 billion francs and was priced at 99.683 percent to yield 1.258 percent annually.
